markingScheme.criterion: Quotes at least two of the student's own logged Symmetry Lab readings (animal, angles tested and mirror positions found, e.g. 'Starfish: 12 angles tested, 5 mirror positions found; Worm: 8 tested, 1 found').
markingScheme.accept: Any two genuine readings consistent with the student's own Investigation Record rows; exact wording not required.
markingScheme.insufficient: A general claim ('starfish are radial') with no logged readings quoted.

markingScheme.criterion: Compares the readings: the radially symmetrical animal (starfish or jellyfish) has several or many mirror positions around a centre, whereas the bilaterally symmetrical animal (worm) has just one.
markingScheme.accept: Any correct comparison stating many (3 or more) mirror positions for the radial animal and one for the bilateral animal.
markingScheme.insufficient: Naming the symmetry types with no reference to the number of mirror positions.

markingScheme.criterion: Links body plan to way of life: a radial animal (slow-moving or attached, meets the world from all sides) versus a bilateral animal (moves in one direction head first, with a front end for sensing and a back end).
markingScheme.accept: Any sensible link such as radial for sessile or slow animals that sense in all directions, bilateral for animals that move headfirst.
markingScheme.insufficient: Saying only 'they live differently' with no body-plan link.

markingScheme.criterion: Explains that the crab grows by molting: it sheds its old rigid exoskeleton and grows a larger one, because the hard shell cannot stretch.
markingScheme.accept: Molting, shedding or changing its shell to a bigger one, with the idea that the shell cannot grow.
markingScheme.insufficient: Saying 'it grows bigger' or 'the shell stretches' with no molting.

markingScheme.criterion: Explains the danger: just after molting the new exoskeleton is soft, so the crab is vulnerable to predators until it hardens.
markingScheme.accept: Soft or unprotected new shell leaving the crab vulnerable to predators or injury.
markingScheme.insufficient: Saying only 'it could get hurt' without linking to the soft new shell.

markingScheme.criterion: Names the phylum Arthropoda and gives a feature: jointed legs and/or a hard exoskeleton.
markingScheme.accept: Arthropoda (arthropods) with jointed legs or an exoskeleton.
markingScheme.insufficient: Naming another phylum, or Arthropoda with no feature.
